title: CarrierStore
description: Storage of carrier energy at a carrier bus, such as a hydrogen tank or a heat storage. It charges and discharges without a power limit of its own; a link limits the flow when needed.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type must have unique names, but components of different types can share a name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`).

bus.description: ID of the carrier bus that this component is connected to.

storage_capacity.description: Maximum energy the store can hold. Units: per energy_units — MWH: MWh, MWMIN: MWmin .

energy_units.description: Unit basis for `storage_capacity`. MWH is the default interchange form; MWMIN records the same energy on the minutes basis used by operational durations.

storage_level_limits.description: Minimum and maximum storage levels as fractions of `storage_capacity`. Units: 1.

initial_storage_level.description: Initial storage level as a fraction of `storage_capacity`. Units: 1.

cyclic.description: Whether the storage level at the end of the horizon must equal the initial level.

self_discharge.description: Fraction of the stored energy lost per minute. Units: 1/min.

variable_cost.description: Cost per unit of energy discharged from the store. Units: USD/MWh.
